description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Greece Greece nationwide compulsory public holidays under the employment-law layer for 2026 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide compulsory public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday baseline. 28 October is included as published in the 2026 Ministry schedule; Gov.gr notes that optional-holiday and employer discretion can apply under the underlying legal framework. Clean Monday, Good Friday and Holy Spirit Monday are not generalized as compulsory closures. Regional, municipal, school, bank, exchange, employer, collective-agreement and sector schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Greece: Greece Easter Monday. | Greece: Greece ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-13"} | {"date":"2026-09-14"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/greece-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/greece-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Greece's pinned 2026 nationwide compulsory public-holiday coverage.

name: check_gr_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Greece nationwide compulsory public holidays under the employment-law layer for 2026

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No national substitute-day closure is inferred; optional, local, employer, sector and later Gazette decisions require separate evidence

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Greece Working Day
